scope: Bounded native stdout telemetry parsing using real two-bot samples and adversarial framing/schema/freshness cases; not gameplay.
checks: real native frame survives every possible chunk split
one-byte chunks and CRLF
partial frames never create a new roster; old data expires

null JSON invalidates readiness without throwing

negative count invalidates readiness without throwing
fractional count invalidates readiness without throwing

bad buttons invalidates readiness without throwing
bad weapon invalidates readiness without throwing

empty frame clears bots immediately
map time reset is allowed and ignores ordinary diagnostic lines
status consumers cannot mutate the internal roster

population metadata commits with the complete bot frame
